residual_diagnoses.distinction_from_surface_form: The problem is not question count, answer length or paragraph length. The problem is that one renderer chooses the focal move and the non-focal next move inside the same local optimization loop.
located_evidence: ‘交接表呢？ / 柜台下面。 / 下面没有。 / 左边。’
‘你还没签。 / 知道。 / 吴兰明早要交。 / 知道。 / 那你现在签了不就行了？’
‘总闸还能用吗？ / 能。 / 你确定？ / 上个月换过里面的保险。 / 上个月？’
causal_chain: focal line or question is generated
same renderer immediately predicts the most relevant non-focal response
reply establishes a narrower shared conversational agenda
same renderer continues completing that agenda
speaker identity becomes recoverable from turn order rather than independent actor behavior
residual_diagnoses.architecture_implication: Separate near-term non-focal response ownership from the prose renderer by freezing observable actor commitments before prose rendering.

residual_diagnoses.distinction_from_surface_form: The problem is not that memories or interpretations exist. The problem is that abstract meaning and semantically matched autobiographical material are simultaneously liquid and immediately available at the instant a concrete object appears.
located_evidence: drawer location -> childhood key memory -> return to paperwork
shared tray-space -> childhood work habit -> explicit relationship meaning
recent fuse repair -> compact thesis that father refuses to admit loss
height marks -> childhood memory -> silent mutual look -> changed relationship pressure
causal_chain: writer already has abstract emotional/relationship interpretation
writer also has directly matched autobiographical residue
memory is retrieved with almost zero friction
narration closes the inference for the reader
residual_diagnoses.architecture_implication: Keep abstract relationship theses and full autobiographical association graphs coordinator-only. Prose writer receives only current perception/body/task and at most a pre-unlocked raw memory fragment without its interpretation.

interaction_between_residuals.explanation: Exact-response dialogue and instant interpretation are two forms of the same local optimization tendency: the renderer converts the immediately available state into the most semantically useful next output. One operates across speakers; the other operates across perception->memory->meaning.
interaction_between_residuals.design_requirement: Change ownership/availability of next-state information rather than adding wording constraints.

preserve: local passage instead of whole-scene completion
change_only: availability of abstract relationship interpretation and autobiographical linkage

component_A.name: PRE_FROZEN_NON_FOCAL_ACTOR_COMMITMENTS
component_A.purpose: Prevent the prose renderer from freely selecting every non-focal next-state solely as a semantic completion of the focal character's immediately previous line.

component_B.name: DEFERRED_ATTRIBUTION_MEMORY_GATE
writer_receives: zero or one explicitly unlocked raw memory fragment
component_B.purpose: Increase friction between object perception and reader-facing interpretive closure.

falsifiable_predictions.prediction: If response ownership is a real residual cause, a prospective passage should show fewer or no blocked exact-adjacency/shared-agenda dialogue stretches without a writer-facing dialogue quota.
If interpretation liquidity is a real residual cause, concrete objects should more often remain sensory/practical for some span rather than immediately producing memory+relationship thesis closure.
If the change only suppresses symptoms, hidden global-optimization signatures will simply migrate to other forms and the candidate will still BLOCK.

pilot_decision_rule: A pilot may be authorized only after a machine-readable schema and single-A1 validation contract demonstrate that both changes are structural, evaluator-hidden, and do not introduce surface quotas or multi-candidate selection.
